inheritance: All discrete-module histories, H2/H3 resolution, display gate, global continuous-colour result, current-climate/topography/soil gates, geographic-provenance gate, JPN38 one-locality colour calibration and JPN29 voucher/taxon-concept gate are inherited from v5 unless overridden below.

jpn38_commons_exhaustion.interpretation: Wikimedia Commons does not add an independent Japanese locality beyond the already-screened Fukushima/Aizu series. The four unlabeled Dalgial files remain geographically unresolved and are not imputed to Korea or Japan.

colour.status: Japan-local colour history remains blocked. Commons has been exhausted as a source of an independent Japanese C. pendulum locality; next recovery must use another source class or direct sampling.

priority_reordering.first: Search non-Commons sources with explicit reusable licensing and Japanese locality for C. pendulum, prioritizing iNaturalist/GBIF-derived observations or institutional image records. Treat license, locality and independence as separate gates before automated measurement.
priority_reordering.second: Resolve PE01523822 / K. Yonekura 6788 determination and annotation history before any Japan-local phenotype is attached to JPN_29.
priority_reordering.third: When at least five Japan-local identity-resolved concepts are available, rerun the continuous-lightness phylogenetic diagnostic with population-matched proxies.
priority_reordering.fourth: Only after the Japan-local trait gate passes, resume radiation/rsds, VPD/aridity, wind/sfcWind and improved-soil mechanism screens.
priority_reordering.do_not_repeat: Do not continue searching the same eight Commons C. pendulum files for an independent Japan locality unless their metadata are externally updated.

claim_boundary: The absence of an independent Japanese locality in the Commons metadata set is a source-coverage result, not evidence that C. pendulum lacks other Japanese populations or photographs elsewhere. Unresolved Commons metadata are not geographically imputed.
